transcript: Jaime Paris et ma soeur aime Paris aussi.

corrections.label: Adjective Agreement
corrections.description: The second « Paris » should be followed by a feminine agreement if you add an adjective.
corrections.explanation: Paris behaves like a feminine city name for agreement purposes when qualified.
corrections.tip: City names are typically treated as feminine when qualified by an adjective.

best_moment: Your use of « ma soeur » introduces a second perspective naturally.
biggest_opportunity: Try adding a reason why both of you like Paris.
improved_answer: J'aime Paris et ma soeur aime Paris aussi.
advanced_answer: J'adore Paris, et ma soeur partage cette passion pour la capitale.
